proof_scope: regression cases for defects observed in live operation, run against the real CLI and the real routing library with an isolated state root

claims.proves: each named failure mode is refused or handled as described, repeatably, through the skill's own entrypoint and routing functions
claims.does_not_prove: that a live repair, closure audit, or completion attestation succeeds. Those dispatch models through $ask/Tau and are proven only by a live receipt read back from the produced artifact, not by this fixture.

cases.name: global-pause-refuses-to-dispatch
command: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/receipts; printf '{"schema":"agent_skills.project_watchdog.registry.v1","projects":[{"project_id":"probe","repo":"o/r","worktree":"/nonexistent"}]}' > $d/p.json; printf '{"global":{"state":"paused"},"projects":{"probe":{"state":"active"}}}' > $d/state.json; PROJECT_WATCHDOG_STATE_ROOT=$d PROJECT_WATCHDOG_PROJECTS_PATH=$d/p.json ../run.sh tick --apply --project probe | grep -o '"status": "[A-Z]*"' | head -1; echo DIRS=$(find $d/receipts -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'project-watchdog-2*' | wc -l)

cases.name: finished-repair-stops-being-routable
command: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import registry, config; i={'number':1,'labels':[{'name':'agent-work'},{'name':config.DONE_LABEL}],'body':'target: src/x.py'}; a,r=registry.classify_issue_with_reason(i); assert a is None and r=='awaiting_review', (a,r); print('REFUSED', r)

cases.name: worktree-holding-unmerged-work-is-not-reset
tick-does-not-revert-an-operator-state-change
command: import sys, json, pathlib, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import commands, config; p=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'state.json'; config.state_path=lambda: p; p.write_text(json.dumps({'projects':{'tau':{'state':'active'}}})); stale={'projects':{'tau':{'state':'active'}},'last_served_project':'tau'}; live=json.loads(p.read_text()); live['projects']['new-project']={'state':'active'}; p.write_text(json.dumps(live)); commands._persist_tick_state(stale); after=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert 'new-project' in after['projects'], after; assert after['last_served_project']=='tau'; print('SURVIVED', sorted(after['projects']))

cases.name: duplicate-closure-is-not-audited-for-proof
single-seat-audit-panel-is-refused
command: import sys, pathlib, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import handlers; calls=[]; handlers.run_cmd=lambda *a, **k: calls.append(a) or {'exit_code':0}; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); proj={'project_id':'p','repo':'o/r','worktree':str(d),'closure_auditors':['claude-opus-4-8']}; iss={'number':9,'title':'t','body':'','labels':[],'url':'u','closedAt':'2026-07-29T00:00:00Z','stateReason':'COMPLETED'}; res=handlers.handle_closure_audit('r', d, proj, iss, apply=True); assert res['status']=='BLOCKED', res; assert 'two distinct seats' in res['summary']; assert not calls; print('PANEL_REFUSED ok')

cases.name: identical-creator-and-reviewer-are-refused
command: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import config; c=config.repair_creator({}); r=config.repair_reviewer({}); assert c!=r, (c,r); assert 'codex' not in r and 'gpt' not in r, r; print('SEATS_DIFFER', c, r)

cases.name: an-unreadable-target-does-not-block-the-fleet
command: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import registry as g; U=g.UNKNOWN_TARGET; assert g.targets_are_blocked({'skills/ticket'}, {U}) is False; assert g.targets_are_blocked({U},{U}) is True; assert g.targets_are_blocked({U}, set()) is False; print('UNKNOWN_ISOLATED ok')

cases.name: a-failed-lease-stops-the-dispatch
command: import sys, pathlib, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import handlers; res={'ok':True,'commands':[]}; handlers.github.issue_edit=lambda *a, **k: {'exit_code':1,'stderr':"label 'agent-active' not found"}; ok=handlers.acquire_lease('r', res, 'o/r', 7); assert ok is False; assert res['status']=='BLOCKED'; assert 'ensure-labels' in res['summary']; print('LEASE_FAILCLOSED ok')

cases.name: a-stall-that-needs-a-human-is-not-reported-as-success
command: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); from watchdog import commands; r={'ok':True,'status':'SKIPPED'}; commands._record_fleet_stall(r,[{'project_id':'a','reason':'project_state_paused'},{'project_id':'b','reason':'lane_busy'}]); assert r['ok'] is False and r['status']=='NEEDS_ATTENTION', r; q={'ok':True,'status':'SKIPPED'}; commands._record_fleet_stall(q,[{'project_id':'a','reason':'lane_busy'}]); assert q['ok'] is True, q; print('STALL_HONEST ok')
